shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; ls __agent_eval__; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/useTheme*.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n -i "deprecated" -r build/esm/components/theme | head; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/CHANGELOG.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat useTheme.d.ts ThemeProvider.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts; cat useTheme.js ThemeProvider.js; cd ..; ls | grep -i -E "switch|radio|segmented|button$"; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags 2>&1 | head; cat tsconfig.json
cd /tmp && npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 peerDependencies --json; (gh api repos/gravity-ui/uikit/releases/tags/v8.0.0 --jq .body 2>&1 | head -60)

mkdir -p /tmp/uikit8 && cd /tmp/uikit8 && npm pack @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --silent 2>&1 | tail -1 && mkdir x && tar -xzf *.tgz -C x && cd x/package && cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; diff <(ls build/esm/components/theme) <(ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme)
grep -n "qa\b\|onUpdate" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
